alreadyVerified.description: Whether an earlier click of the link verified it: a link stays valid for its hour.

kind.description:
How the state began; baseline for an entity's first state at the start of the index's
coverage, compared to nothing.

changedFields.description: The fields the opener changed; none for a new entity.

openerLink.description:
The opener's page, which « Inchangé depuis le patch X » links: its versioned URL, or the

canonical.description: The state's canonical: its opener once closed, the short URL while open.

EntityState.description:
The state of the entity that holds the page's version: the run of versions over
which its page shows the same thing, and the version that opened it.

FavoriteBoard.description: The four favorite slots of a profile, resolved on one patch.

and removed), or a text by its segments.

A text's diff, word by word (character by character in ja, zh, th), to write as text in

another kind, and for a text neither side has in the page's language.

FieldChange.description:
A field of the block « Ce qui a changé dans ce patch », its values in the page's language:
exactly the fields the index marks changed, each shown even when its two localized values
are equal, or when neither side has one (no values, no segments).

email.description: The e-mail of the account, whatever the case.

username.description:

width.description: Its width in pixels, the `w` descriptor of the candidate.

ImageVariant.description: A WebP variant of an art, stored by the site: one candidate of a srcset.

ImportPreview.description: A build carried over to another patch, and what the carrying changed.

championMissing.description:

runesReset.description: Whether the rune page was blanked because one of its ids is gone.

droppedItems.description: The items left out, in step order.

An item as the list shows it: what it builds into, and the values its facets filter on:
tags, edition, maps, tier, price, stats.

The page search engines index for the entity: never null, the page itself when no

profile.description: The facts of the list's card, the edition and its twin among them.

description.description: Riot's rich text, unresolved template tokens removed.

Price of an item: int ItemGold.Base is the combine cost on top of the components,

icons of the cards' `upgrades`.

Whether each (version, locale) the epoch already holds for every type asked (the latest
completed unit over each of them failed no page) is left out.

The automatic queue of the pre-rendering as the admin shows it: whether it runs, what it
holds, what it wrote lately, and its most requested pending pages.

observedAt.description: When this instance last ran the engine; null when it never did.

isWorkerEnabled.description: Whether this instance runs its background tasks (LoDb:Workers:Enabled).

ssrUnreachableSince.description: Since when the SSR is out of reach for the pass; null while it answers.

waiting.description: The versions of this pass whose units wait.

oneOf.description:
How much of the older patches it holds, (version, locale) by (version, locale); null for

a unit completed (its catalog is stored); null when none did.

openers.description:

TrendsPage.description: A page of the trends, with the filters it applied and the facets to change them.

UiLocale.description: Interface locale of the site, carried as the first URL segment (`/{locale}/…`).

oneOf.description: The account as stored now; null once deleted, its trail staying.

UserActivity.description: The activity of one account: the account, if it still exists, and a page.

ValueKind.description:
What a value of a field is, which tells the front how to show it. Every value travels as an
invariant string: OpenAPI refuses unions of numbers and strings.

token.description: The `token` parameter of the link, as it is.

VerifyEmailRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/account/verify-email`: the parameters of the link.

VersionCoverage.description: The datasets stored for one version.

VersionRow.description: A Data Dragon version and where its ingestion stands.

current.description: The version served as the latest; null before the first promotion.

recent.description: The versions changed last, the latest change first.

VersionState.description: The Data Dragon versions known to the database.

isPublic.description: Whether visitors see the public card; a private one answers them 404.

value.description: `up` or `down`; the direction the caller already voted withdraws the vote.

VoteRequest.description: A vote on a public build.

myVote.description: 1 or -1 for the caller's vote; 0 without one, or for a visitor.

VoteState.description: The votes on a public build: the net score only, and the caller's own vote.

WarmUpLanding.description: The entry whose image was fetched last, named in the requested language.

total.description: Images the run fetches, over every resource; 0 while preparing.

resources.description: The requested resources, in the requested order.

oneOf.description: The image fetched last; null before the first one.

failure.description: The problem code that ended a failed run, as a catalog call answers it.

WarmUpProgress.description:
One frame of the warm-up stream: the whole state of the run, never a delta, so a client
keeps the last frame it read and loses nothing to a frame it skipped.

total.description: Images of the list the manifest had no verdict for; 0 while preparing.

ready.description: Whether every image of the list has its verdict: its row reads "ready".

WarmUpResource.description: How far the images of one resource's list have come.

WarmUpStage.description: Where a warm-up stands; the last two end the stream.
